text:
jordan: Quick sync — competitor Nova shipped a 'smart-routing' feature across their hosted API. Proposal: we prioritize a small initiative to close parity on routing + fallback. Need product + eng + CS alignment by EOD Friday.

leena: Can you paste a quick summary of what they actually shipped? link? :thinking:

jordan: Short summary from their public notes: per-model routing based on token budgets, automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants when latency/cost thresholds hit, and an eviction policy for KV cache to reduce tail latencies. They claim ~20% unit cost reduction on average. Link: https://nova.ai/blog/smart-routing (screenshot in thread).

owen: From infra perspective the core pieces are: routing policy engine, lightweight model proxies that can swap variants mid-request, and metric plumbing for cost/latency signals. Ballpark: 4 wks for an MVP with 2 engs + infra support.

elaine: Sales/CS signal: we've already had 3 incoming asks for 'fallback to cheaper model' — customers frame this as cost-control. If we ship this we should position it as 'automatic cost-aware routing' in the one-pager. :rocket:

leena: Suggested launch criteria so we have measurable gates: (a) policy config (UI + JSON) so customers can control routing, (b) SLA on added tail latency <50ms for 95th, (c) telemetry showing cost delta >=10% for >=70% of test workloads, (d) per-customer opt-out and audit logs. Thoughts?

mike: Need to add eval safety gates: run 5k prompts across top-10 customer prompt sets to detect quality regressions when falling back. Also verify variant compatibility (tokenization, output schema). We'll flag any >2% drop in helpfulness score.

jordan: Scope negotiation: MVP = routing engine + 2 fallback strategies (1: quantized smaller model, 2: lower-capacity tier). Defer autoscaling heuristics, adaptive thresholds, and UI polish to V2.

owen: Sounds reasonable. Q: Hosted-only first or must we include Dedicated? Dedicated customers will demand deterministic control and model pins — that adds ~2wks.

leena: @owen mark Dedicated as 'enterprise checkbox' — we require a support plan to enable it. Prioritize Hosted for MVP so we can ship faster.

elaine: CS asks that opt-out + audit events be non-negotiable for launch. Also want a short troubleshooting playbook.

jordan: Ok adding 'per-customer opt-out', 'audit events', and a one-page runbook to launch criteria. @owen can you re-run the estimate with those included?

owen: Estimate updated: +1 eng-week for opt-out hooks and audit pipeline integration. New MVP ETA ~5 weeks with the same headcount. We'll need a spike week before the sprint to validate proxy approach.

leena: Product decision: greenlight MVP into sprint 42 if eng confirms resource allocation. @mike please produce the eval plan by Tue so we can include metrics in the PRD.

mike: On it — will drop eval plan + a quick runner. Example command for smoke eval: ```python eval_runner.py --customers top10 --n 500 --save-results results.json```

jordan: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short PRD and a leadership one-pager today and post in #product-review tomorrow morning.

elaine: Sales request: 1-pager positioning headline: "Control cost & reliability without code changes." Also include a simple before/after cost example.

owen: Noted. KPIs to track post-launch: tail latency (95/99), cost savings %, fallback error rate, and customer opt-outs. We'll spike a PoC next week.

leena: Closing notes / owners: Jordan (PM lead), Owen (eng lead), Mike (evals), Elaine (sales/CS). If no objections I'll update the roadmap doc and add the ticket set.

jordan: No objections. Thanks all.
